svg.text: fd09_tage: the loop's fetch blocks and branch positions
One cell per halfword. The numbers in a fetch block are positions: halfwords from the block start. NUM_PRED_SLOTS = 1. Read from out/fd09_tage/fd09_tage.fst at p2.
address 0x8000_00xx, the low byte of each halfword:
Labels as in the section 3 listing. Loop body top to BE, epilogue from 0x8000_001A. B targets dest, BE targets top.
top, before the split (cyc 23, FTB miss): a 32-byte fetch block, 0x8000_0008 to 0x8000_0028. B at position 3, BE at 7.
top, after the split (FTB hit from cyc 34, 349 p2 cycles): 0x8000_0008 to 0x8000_0016. Slot 0 is B, position 3.
ft, after a backend redirect for B resolved not taken (FTB hit from cyc 127, 14 p2 cycles): 0x8000_0012 to 0x8000_0032. Slot 0 is BE, position 2.
dest, B taken (FTB hit from cyc 88, 55 p2 cycles): 0x8000_0014 to 0x8000_0034. Slot 0 is BE, position 1.
BE, the fall-through of top (FTB hit from cyc 46, 308 p2 cycles): 0x8000_0016 to 0x8000_0036. Slot 0 is BE, position 0.
fetch block with an FTB entry
FTB miss: a 32-byte fetch block with no branch
conditional branch, labeled in its first halfword below
Start: u_bpu.r_pc_p2. End: bpu_blk_pft_p2, the first halfword after the fetch block. Position: bpu_slot_p2.[0].pos, in halfwords from the block start.
A block's p2 cycles are those with r_val_p2 and w_ftb_valid_p2 at that start, wrong-path cycles included. An FTB miss gives no slot (slot_valid 0).
The split is ftb_decisions.md section 3, at cyc 32: from then on the fetch block at top ends at BE, and BE starts a fetch block of its own.
